paragraphs.text: Frankie "the Fang" is a Vampire outlaw from an unknown plane.

Frankie is a character who was introduced in Outlaws of Thunder Junction . She is from an unknown plane and traveled to Thunder Junction between 4562 and 4563 AR , where she has a bounty outstanding. After entering the plane, she joined the Hellspurs . She has pale skin with bright red hair, wears black armor, and wields a dagger whose blade glows red.
